Shaadi Shutter — Wedding Photography & Reels, Chandigarh

Shaadi Shutter is a Chandigarh-based photography and short-form-video studio
popular with younger couples for its Instagram-style reels and trendy editing.
They cover weddings across Punjab and Himachal and pride themselves on fast
social-media-ready deliverables.

Their standard package (two days, photo plus reels) is ₹1,05,000, with
full-length films as an add-on.

Contact: +91 97790 55410 · team@shaadishutter.example
Location: Sector 17, Chandigarh
Rating: 4.5 / 5 (142 reviews)

What couples say:
"Reels were trending-ready within a day — loved it."
"Young, energetic team with fresh ideas."
"Good value for the social-media coverage."

Shaadi Shutter focuses on quick teaser delivery and offers a same-day reel for
the sangeet or mehendi on request.
